Initial release of smyx-pet-stool-morphology-recognition-analysis.

- Analyze dog toilet or outdoor dog-walking area images/videos for pet stool morphology.
- Supports color (brown, black, red, white), shape (formed, loose, watery, granular), and blood/mucus presence detection.
- Triggers via local file uploads, network URLs, and specific user requests.
- Outputs standardized observation features to help early detection of gastrointestinal issues (no diagnosis or treatment).
- Includes strict open-id acquisition workflow and consistent cloud-based history report retrieval.
- Designed for dog toilets, outdoor monitoring, multi-pet households, and pet health tracking scenarios.
